inj.note: Head coach Mike LaFleur told Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site Friday that Love was expected to play in Week 8, and the running back's lack of designation confirms as much. After opening the week with back-to-back limited listings, Love capped it with a full session Friday, indicating that he's ready for close to a normal workload Sunday after a two-game absence. Speaking of the time off, Love relayed to Urban that "two weeks for anybody will get people feeling how they want to feel." As a result, Love will rejoin a backfield that previously was a near-even split between Tyler Allgeier (toe) and Bam Knight the last two weeks.

news.h: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) set to return
news.d: Jeremiyah Love is expected to return to the field for the Cardinals on Sunday after missing the past two weeks with an ankle injury.

news.h: Cards rookie RB Jeremiyah Love to miss second straight game with ankle injury
news.d: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love will miss his second straight game Sunday as he continues to recover from an ankle injury.

news.h: Cardinals 'do what's right,' rule RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) out vs. Rams
news.d: The Cardinals say they're doing "what's right" for RB Jeremiyah Love by ruling the prized rookie out for Sunday's game against the Rams due to his injured left ankle.
